description.fun: Exeggcute look like a clutch of six eggs but are really closer to seeds. The six talk to each other with a telepathy only they understand, and they need all six to feel steady; one short, and they get nervous and may recruit a similar-sized Pokémon to fill the gap. More cracks in the shells mean it's close to evolving, and when it does, all six merge into a single Exeggutor.
description.guide: A group of six egg-like Grass and Psychic Pokémon that are actually closer to seeds. The six communicate telepathically and stay together as a group. It evolves into Exeggutor with a Leaf Stone, or into Alolan Exeggutor if it evolves in Alola.
description.tagline: Six psychic eggs that are actually seeds

description.fun: Exeggutor is a walking palm tree with three coconut heads that each think for themselves and speak their minds, though they never squabble; if they all want to go different ways, the body simply stays put. A head that grows too big falls off and becomes an Exeggcute. It's been called 'the walking tropical rainforest', and it gets sluggish on cloudy days.
description.guide: The evolution of Exeggcute with a Leaf Stone, a palm tree-like Grass and Psychic Pokémon with three coconut-shaped heads that think independently. A head that grows too large can fall off and become an Exeggcute. Its Alolan form is a very tall Grass and Dragon type.
description.tagline: A three-headed palm tree that can't always agree where to go

description.fun: Alola's strong sun makes Exeggutor grow over five times taller, with a long neck and a fourth head on its tail that guards the rear. Alolans say this is how Exeggutor ought to look, though swinging that long neck in battle makes it dizzy.

note.text: Same Leaf Stone, different place: any Exeggcute that evolves in Alola becomes Alolan Exeggutor, wherever it came from.
